instruction: I want to research the attendance numbers for the three machine learning conferences (ICLR, ICML, Neurips) from 2013 to 2019. I have prepared a table with conference names and years in columns A and B. Please fill in the approximate attendance count for each conference-year pair in column C.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires researching and filling approximate attendance counts for ML conferences from 2013-2019 in a structured table. Evaluator validates: (1) correct table structure with 3 conferences × 7 years = 21 rows, (2) each attendance value is paired with the correct conference name and year, (3) attendance values match expected with 10% tolerance. Structure validation (40% weight) ensures semantic correctness, value validation (60% weight) checks attendance accuracy.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator validates all 21 conference-year-attendance entries with correct structure validation (40% weight) and value validation (60% weight)
Correct semantic structure validation: Metric checks that each attendance value is paired with the correct conference name (ICLR/ICML/Neurips) and year (2013-2019) by reading from columns A, B, and C
Appropriate tolerance logic: 10% tolerance for attendance values correctly handles 'approximate' nature of the task requirement
Robust data extraction: Properly extracts and validates conference names (with normalization), years (with type handling), and attendance values from the correct cells
Correct expected parameter handling: Uses 'expected.get("expected_values", [])' pattern correctly for type:rule configuration
Proper postconfig: Activates window and saves file to ensure fresh state for verification
Good edge case handling: Handles None values, type conversion errors, and normalizes conference names for comparison
